# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.deno/bin/deno
# args: 
Deno kernel for Jupyter notebooks

Usage: deno jupyter [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --install           Install a kernelspec
  -n, --name <VALUE>      Set a name for the kernel (defaults to 'deno'). Useful when maintaing multiple Deno kernels.
  -d, --display <VALUE>   Set a display name for the kernel (defaults to 'Deno'). Useful when maintaing multiple Deno kernels.
      --kernel            Start the kernel
      --conn <VALUE>      Path to JSON file describing connection parameters, provided by Jupyter
      --force             Force installation of a kernel, overwriting previously existing kernelspec
